hypothesis: The learned alias dynamics compose with ordinary directed contacts without losing persistent latent-mode uncertainty before informative feedback or correct predictions afterward.

families.withheld_alias: ab with b withheld, cc with b withheld, observe all, ba, ab
families.mode_coalescence: ab with b withheld, ab fully observed, cc, ab, ba

data.initial: a=1, b=0, c=0/1; remaining coordinates sampled before mode realization
data.views: Both persistent modes and both global role directions per blueprint; mode/direction twins are dependent, with one physical lineage per family/N/prebit.
data.freshness: Report canonical blueprint and template overlap against prospective, continuation and alias-v1/v2 train/reserved/evaluation archives before collection; no rejection using observed outcomes or learned predictions.

training: Reuse all ten committed alias-v2 checkpoints byte-for-byte; no fitting, adaptation, selection or retries.

analysis.criteria: Each seed and family: >=95% identifiable full-world accuracy, complete support, zero newly wrong identifiable predictions against paired ordinary control, zero MAP worlds outside information support, zero definitely unchanged-bit errors; >=95% identifiable role-pair conjunctions. Mean KL(oracle||forecast)<=0.05 nats separately in each family's identifiable and ambiguous strata; every ambiguous joint forecast TV<=0.1.
analysis.probability_scope: Compare full joint distributions including soft tails, without oracle renormalization. Law-conditional predictive fidelity is not general epistemic calibration.
analysis.historical_metrics: Retain all-action realized accuracy/NLL/Brier, realized unchanged-bit errors, every repair/regression ID, missing output and failure. The original >=95% in-family gate is unchanged and is not claimed passed by this study.
analysis.known_unchanged: A coordinate has the same unique value across all prior worlds consistent with delivered feedback and all post-action oracle worlds.
analysis.dependence: Descriptive finite-bank comparison; seeds, directions and mode twins are not independent physical samples.
analysis.g2_limits: Ordered binary contacts only. Simultaneous interactions, independently varied multi-source laws, general calibration and independent challenge custody remain unestablished.

decision_order: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION if any unproduced trial, terminal failure or invalid artifact
REVISE_MIXED_COMPOSITION if any frozen candidate criterion fails
KEEP_MIXED_COMPOSITION otherwise; continue bounded G2 development without refitting this bank
